name: HackerOne
description: Leading bug bounty platform using Hai Triage (Human + AI) for vulnerability validation. Tracks hacker reputation scores over time and facilitates coordinated disclosure per ISO 29147.

peerReview.processDescription: Hai Triage: Agentic Validation (AI-powered initial classification in 5-15 min) then human analyst validation then CVSS severity and bounty recommendation. Disclosure Assistance team facilitates coordinated disclosure.

attribution.attributionNotes: Hacktivity (public feed of disclosed reports), Top 100/1000 rankings, CVE credits, reputation scores.

povsAlignment.description: Vulnerability disclosure platform with AI-assisted triage and public Hacktivity feed.
